summary.text: Mark Hart is a Republican state representative from Kentucky House District 78 who has served since 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A firefighter and paramedic by profession, he is a veteran of the Kentucky Army National Guard.

paragraphs.text: Mark Hart was born in Falmouth, Kentucky, graduated from Pendleton City Memorial High School, and served in the Kentucky Army National Guard from 1994 to 2003.
He earned a bachelor of science in biology and psychology from Northern Kentucky University.
His career experience includes working as an EMS and paramedic captain with Pendleton County and as an EMS paramedic and firefighter with the City of Lexington.
Hart founded Pendleton County Search and Rescue and has been a member of the Kincaid Regional Theater Board, the American Legion, and the Masonic Lodge.
Hart took office in the Kentucky House in 2017.

In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Agriculture Committee, the Appropriations and Revenue Committee, the Local Government Committee, and the Veterans, Military Affairs, and Public Protection Committee.
